change_summary: Fixture legends review — three reviewers, consensus, no real data.

reviewers.name: Elon Musk
reviewers.verdict: Ship it, but delete the middleware layer.
reviewers.hard_truth: The architecture is fine. The velocity is not.

reviewers.name: Steve Jobs
reviewers.verdict: Someone cared about this. Now care about the error messages too.
reviewers.hard_truth: This is a collection of endpoints, not a product.

reviewers.name: Linus Torvalds
reviewers.verdict: The error handling is correct. That's rarer than you think.
reviewers.hard_truth: This will break at 3 AM and whoever is on call will curse your name.

agreements: Delete the middleware abstraction — it creates complexity without removing any.

disagreements.resolution: Linus won: it prevents a class of runtime errors.

findings.title: Middleware abstraction earns nothing
findings.description: One implementation, one caller, zero variation points.
findings.recommendation: Delete the layer and inline the call.

findings.title: Error messages abandon the user
findings.description: A 400 with no body tells the integrator nothing.
findings.recommendation: Return a message that names the invalid field and the expected format.
